venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 7/31 (MOD Jk MKZ).** Strong Friday, +22% over target ($7,662 vs $6,267). Beautiful Atlanta weather brought people out early; smooth summer-Friday start with a nice crowd from open. DJ Jamie set the mood perfectly from 9pm. Down a barback, so BOH stepped up heavily to support FOH (reminder to flag food orders to Keyshawn when he's up front helping). Great team effort on glasses and bussing. Opener cut ~10:30pm; kitchen closed a little after 1am with a consistent flow of guests to end of night, capped by lots of industry folk coming in late. 86'd coasters and white towels. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: A little hotter, but nice; foot traffic picked up ~9pm
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 7/31 (MOD MD/KE & Chef JMS).** Beat target ($9,516 vs $9,221, +3%) on a slower-paced Friday. Only ~$850 in sales at 7pm; the bulk came 9pm–11:30pm with a small pop around midnight, then a $250 group spend at last call sealed it. Sun Cruiser rep in with a small spend. DJ read the room — disco ball moment got an audible 'woo' — and vibes were great with lots of first-timers promising to return. Comps just 0.8% (gift, industry, manager, Neuhoff resident, bingo). Maintenance: CO2/nitrogen still acting up (see Kala); kitchen freezer. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 7/31 (AM Evan & Carey / PM Maggie S & Evan).** Beat target ($20,245 vs $19,065, +6%) despite a monsoon: massive hail at 7pm flooded the Garden ($1,330 before it shut), and staff moved everyone to the lobby — guests laughing about the summer storm, great job all around. Steady, controlled crowd after 9pm into a smooth close; openers cut at 11pm and closers knocked out the big inventory close. AM did $1,782 with Heather in on her day off. Splits: DC/AM $1,782, D&C PM $17,334, Garden $1,330; food $2,322. Toast is working; a rescheduled Toast-transition group came back and had a great time. Three tables called the MOD over to praise servers. Break makeup not complete. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 7/31 (MOD Kyler / Chef Steves).** Beat target ($8,573 vs $7,911, +8%) on a bumping Friday. Slow start, then full by 7:30pm with a sustained medium waitlist that didn't clear until 12:30am. Haleigh packed the room; Jane and Peter rocked service; Seth held point — tight pacing all night. Top sellers: Native Lion, King Mambo/Shinebox (tie), Eight Limb Daiquiri. Food a strong $1,023. Welcomed new investor Lyra Levin, regulars, 6 birthdays and a bar-exam celebration; no no-shows. Comps $268 (investors, members, DNLs). Breakage: 3 DOF, coupe, collins, mini coupe.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 7/31 (backfilled noon pass; report posted 8/1 7:45am ET; report's 'Saturday' note is a typo — matched by post time).** MOD/Chef: Gigi + Joe + Josh + Saleh. Weather: another humid day. Net sales $11,024 vs target $11,919. Food sales $1,488; Standing Room $2,917; Marquee $8,107. Comps $424 (Sabrina, Javier, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL, service recovery). Guests 290, check avg $93.43. A pretty steady night — started with 93 covers, bar top filled immediately, walk-ins slow until ~7pm as humid weather kept folks in until sundown. Marquee filled ~8pm, standing room gradually after; big waitlist after 9pm, team burned and turned to seat everyone quickly. Midnight reservations gave one last push at last call. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: seeing a bunch of family faces.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 7/31 (backfilled noon pass; report posted 8/1 8:16am ET).** MOD: Marcus / Josh. Weather: hot. Total net sales incl. events $11,359.13 vs target $8,407 — crushed the goal. Marquee bar $9,584.13; Garden $1,775; Food $1,122; Total sales $11,583.99. Comps $224.86 (1.97%), voids $60 (0.52%, avoidable mistakes). Guests 237; GCA $42.86, check avg $85.65. Garden started slow in the heat (first guests ~7pm) then picked up after sundown, including groups from Otakon; team kept energy up and worked the waitlist smoothly. Inside, steady flow start to finish with a good resy/walk-in mix, quick ticket times, smart table turns. Coaching notes: ring orders immediately, tighten pre-bussing and water service. Kitchen solid, all positive feedback. No incidents; no-shows NOT charged. Maintenance: service well sink. Favorite moment: industry friend in for a couple rounds.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 7/31 (AM Braden & Lex / PM James & Shannon).** Big night, +33% over target ($14,654 vs $11,000), boosted by a smooth $5,434 event (Democratic rally on the mezzanine — sold plenty of Blue Wave cocktails; Alexis and Sierra crushed it). Decent off-season Friday morning with two tour groups and a lunch pop; 3pm storm briefly closed Sun Club ($240). Evening steady but relaxed — bar busy all night, great food/drink times, never much of a wait. Hot Eye slow ($1,410); Seba left ill before midnight. Comps $676 nominal, but ~$484 was event drinks rung for inventory tracking — true comp cost ~$192. Fruit flies remain a persistent battle (shoo-fly on order). Favorite moment: staff singing happy birthday to Sam Bags at Hot Eye at midnight.
